`dtype` for browser models is defined and used mainly in the local browser model layer, but it is not carried through the shared browser model metadata type used by the UI/prefs.

1. Where `dtype` is declared for browser models  
- Declaration: `BrowserModelSpec` includes `dtype: string | Record<string, string>` in `web/src/stores/local-model.ts`.  
- This file also defines the browser catalogue (`BROWSER_MODELS`) and assigns `dtype` per model there (including QAT-style per-module maps).  
- The loader passes it directly into `AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained(...)` as `spec.dtype as any` in the same file (`performLoad`), so typing safety is intentionally bypassed there.

2. Where browser model metadata is projected/validated  
- Browser metadata is projected into the app-facing model list in `web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx` via `makeBrowserModels()`, which builds `Model<Api>` objects and does not include `dtype` (or `kind`/`blurb`) in the projected shape.  
- Stored/persisted model prefs are validated in `web/src/keating/model-prefs.ts` (`SavedModel` and normalization) and also do not contain `dtype`; only generic fields like `id`, `name`, `provider`, `api`, `baseUrl`, `reasoning`, `vision` are handled.  
- The shared capabilities/provider model shape in `web/src/keating/providers/capabilities.ts` also does not include `dtype`.

3. Mismatches found (browser list typing/metadata, especially `dtype`)  
- `dtype` exists only in `BrowserModelSpec` (local-model catalog) and is dropped when models are exposed as `Model<Api>` for selector state/persistence.  
- No validation layer ensures a selected/stored browser model still carries `dtype`, because `dtype` is not part of saved schema.  
- `performLoad` uses `spec.dtype as any`, so mismatched `dtype` values are not protected by TypeScript at call site.  
- Secondary mismatch (not dtype-specific but related): browser entries with `kind: "multimodal"` are projected with `input: ["text"]`, so capability/UI representation can understate vision support.

Key files to inspect:  
- `[web/src/stores/local-model.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/stores/local-model.ts)`  
- `[web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/components/ModelSelector.tsx)`  
- `[web/src/keating/model-prefs.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/model-prefs.ts)`  
- `[web/src/keating/providers/capabilities.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/keating/providers/capabilities.ts)`  

Would you like me to prepare a concrete patch that carries `dtype` through the browser-model `Model<Api>` path (plus aligns `input`/vision metadata with `kind`) while keeping persistence backward-compatible?
